newsitem.title: CANADA: Koch Oil raises Canada posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Koch Oil raises Canada posted oil prices.

text.p: Koch Oil Co Ltd said it raised the price it would pay for Edmonton light sweet crude oil by C$3.00/cubic metre or C$0.48/barrel, to C$202.00/cubic metre or C$32.12/barrel, effective immediately.
Other new prices were listed as follows:
Cromer light sour C$198.00/cubic metre, or C$31.48/barrel
Bow River at Hardisty C$177.00/cubic metre, or C$28.14/barrel
Hardisty medium C$186.00/cubic metre, or C$29.57/barrel
Midale at Cromer C$187.00/cubic metre, or C$29.73/barrel
